description: Compares a Gaussian copula generator against independent marginal sampling on 4-feature tabular data, scoring distribution fidelity (KS, correlation, TV) and downstream LR accuracy.
method: Algorithm (Gaussian copula): fit per-feature marginals (Normal for 2 continuous, empirical-CDF for 2 discrete of 3 and 4 levels), rank-transform all 4 features plus the binary label to standard-normal space, fit a 5x5 covariance, draw n_synthetic=256 samples, inverse-transform back. Baseline (independent marginals): sample each feature and the label from its own fitted marginal, discarding all cross-feature correlations. Validation: seeded 70/30 stratified split of the 'real' data; synthetic sets match training-set size; all fidelity metrics compare synthetic vs the held-out real test; utility trains a LogisticRegression on the synthetic set and scores on the real test. Metrics (direction): ks_continuous (lower=better, mean two-sample KS over the 2 continuous features), tv_discrete (lower=better, mean total-variation distance over the 2 discrete features), corr_mae (lower=better, MAE over the 6 pairwise correlations of the 4 features), utility_algo_acc and utility_base_acc (higher=better, LR accuracy on real test). No temporal ordering applies (i.i.d. synthetic data); stratification prevents class imbalance leakage.
category: Synthetic data generation with distribution and utility evaluation
